_note: A case a connected system opened keeps where it came from (decision 206). Generic on purpose: the adapter that received the message (integriq, for StUF-ZDS) names the connection, and dossiq stores the connection id and the identifier the system gave the case, so a later message from the same system finds the same case. Neither field is a wire format's name.

originSystem.title: Origin system
originSystem.description: The connection through which a connected system opened this case. Empty for a case opened in dossiq.

originIdentifier.title: Origin identifier
originIdentifier.description: The identifier the connected system gave this case, so its later messages find it. Empty for a case opened in dossiq.
